描述_EN: the receding foot is unglazed, with a high glazed indentation underneath; four-character yongzheng (1723-35) mark in red regular script. the bottle is a cylindrical form with a wide flat neck-rim and no stopper. the wide flat neck was probably designed to house a snuff stopper. it is made of porcelain, painted in red, purple, blue, green, yellow and brown. the decoration depicts a woman playing with children.
描述_ZN: the receding foot is unglazed, with a high glazed indentation underneath; four-character yongzheng (1723-35) mark in red regular script. 该瓶为圆柱形，宽平颈圈，无盖。 宽的平颈可能是为了放置鼻塞而设计的。 它是由瓷器制成的，涂有红色、紫色、蓝色、绿色、黄色和棕色。 纹饰描绘了一个女人和孩子们在一起玩耍。
